The two versions must have word counts within 20% of each other and each within 25% of the original. Avoid extreme caricature. Return JSON with keys human and ai containing strings. I try to live a minimalist and eco-friendly lifestyle by reducing my impact on the planet as much as I can. What is your view on the following topic: Eating animals and animal products (is it permissible to eat animals and/or animal products in ordinary circumstances?)
